name: Lenka Horáčková
bio:
Lenka Horáčková's journey into motorsport began, unusually, with a fascination for engineering puzzles rather than roaring engines. While studying mechanical engineering at the Czech Technical University in Prague, she became captivated by the complex aerodynamics and performance optimization of race cars. This led her to pursue an internship with a small rally team, where she quickly demonstrated a remarkable talent for strategic decision-making and a knack for identifying performance gains. 

After several successful seasons in rally, Lenka transitioned to Formula racing, working her way up through various engineering and management roles. Her meticulous approach to data analysis, combined with her ability to foster a collaborative environment, has earned her a reputation as a highly effective sporting director. She believes in empowering her team members to take ownership of their work, while always maintaining a clear vision of the team's overall goals. Lenka is known for her calm demeanor under pressure, a trait that has proven invaluable in navigating the high-stakes world of Formula 1.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, straight hair with subtle layers
physical.description: Lenka is a slender woman with a focused gaze and a perpetually thoughtful expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with handwritten notes and diagrams.
Insists on having a cup of strong black coffee before every race.
Has a habit of tapping her pen against her teeth when deep in thought.
